name: Solana
why: Solana is drawing attention amid a sharp crypto-market selloff, with traders linking its weakness to Bitcoin's decline, broad risk-off sentiment and leveraged selling. name: Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares

name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
why: Renewed tariff proposals and concerns that they could keep inflation elevated are weighing on the market, with traders also watching PCE and GDP data for clues about the Fed's rate path as technology and AI-linked stocks sell off. Bearish calls for further declines dominate, though some traders see the pullback as overdone and are buying the dip.

name: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF
why: Hawkish Fed signals and persistent inflation have put rate hikes and rising Treasury yields at the center of the discussion, with traders debating whether higher yields will keep pressure on TLT. Others see the equity selloff and recession risks prompting a flight to long bonds, so the community is split between near-term bearishness and expectations of a safe-haven rally.
